It was engraved on certain antique gemstones, called on that account Abraxas stones, which were used as amulets or charms.

nodes.summary: According to ancient and medieval science, aether, also known as the fifth element or quintessence, is the material that fills the region of the universe beyond the terrestrial sphere. The concept of aether was used in several theories to explain several natural phenomena, such as the propagation of light and gravity. In the late 19th century, physicists postulated that aether permeated space, providing a medium through which light could travel in a vacuum, but evidence for the presence of such a medium was not found in the Michelson–Morley experiment, and this result has been interpreted to mean that no luminiferous aether exists.

Agon is the Greek deity who personified conflict, struggle or contest. This could be a contest in athletics, in chariot or horse racing, or in music or literature at a public festival in ancient Greece. Agon is the word-forming element in 'agony', explaining the concept of agon(y) in tragedy by its fundamental characters, the protagonist and antagonist.
nodes.category: Ancient Greek personification of struggle or competition

nodes.summary: The American Civil War was a civil war in the United States between the Union and the Confederacy, which was formed in 1861 by Southern states that had seceded from the Union to preserve the institution of slavery. The South saw slavery as threatened because of the election of Abraham Lincoln as president in 1860, the abolitionist movement, and the growing electoral power of the North. The war ended with a Union victory, dissolution of the Confederacy and the national abolition of slavery, freeing four million African Americans.

nodes.summary: The American frontier encompasses the geography, history, folklore, and culture associated with the forward wave of American expansion in mainland North America that began with European colonial settlements in the early 17th century and ended with the admission of the last few contiguous western territories as states in 1912. This era of massive migration and settlement was particularly encouraged by President Thomas Jefferson following the Louisiana Purchase, giving rise to the expansionist attitude known as "manifest destiny" and historians' "Frontier Thesis". The legends, historical events, and folklore of the American frontier, known as the frontier myth, have embedded themselves into United States culture so much so that the Old West, and the Western genre of media specifically, has become one of the defining features of American national identity.

The Azure Dragon is one of the Dragon Gods who represent the mounts or chthonic forces of the Five Regions' Highest Deities. nodes.summary: Blade Runner is a 1982 science fiction film directed by Ridley Scott from a screenplay by Hampton Fancher and David Peoples. Starring Harrison Ford, Rutger Hauer, Sean Young, and Edward James Olmos, it is an adaptation of the 1968 novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? by Philip K. Dick. The film is set in a dystopian future Los Angeles of 2019, in which synthetic humans known as replicants are bio-engineered by the powerful Tyrell Corporation to work on space colonies. When a fugitive group of advanced replicants led by Roy Batty (Hauer) escapes back to Earth, former cop Rick Deckard (Ford) is recalled to hunt them down.

The Book of Genesis is the first book of the Hebrew Bible and the Christian Old Testament. The Hebrew name bereshit is taken directly from the first word. The primary narrative of Genesis includes a legendary account of the creation of the world, the early history of the human race, and the origins of the Jewish people. At the height of the Carnevale celebration, a Laurel is bestowed by the Sentinel to the best performer, crowning them as Laureate and granting them a brief communication with the Sentinel.

The Chimera, Chimaera, Chimæra, or Khimaira was a monstrous fire-breathing hybrid creature in Greek mythology, said to be from Lycia, Asia Minor, and composed of different animal parts. Typically, it is depicted as a lion with a goat's head protruding from its back and a tail ending with a snake's head. Some representations also include dragon's wings. It was an offspring of Typhon and Echidna and a sibling of monsters like Cerberus and the Lernaean Hydra.
nodes.category: Mythical or fictional creature with parts taken from various animals

nodes.summary: The Chinese dragon, known as long or loong, is a legendary creature in Chinese mythology, Chinese folklore, and Chinese culture generally. Chinese dragons have many animal-like forms, such as turtles and fish, but are most commonly depicted as snake-like with four legs. Academics have identified four reliable theories on the origin of the Chinese dragon: snakes, Chinese alligators, thunder worship and nature worship. They traditionally symbolize potent and auspicious powers, particularly control over water and weather.

nodes.summary: The Court of Savantae 稷廷 is a research organization with various laboratories scattered across Solaris. It was at the cutting edge of research into the Lament and related phenomena since the original lament 10,000 years ago. While the ruins in Whining Aix's Mire were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court's living membership appears to have been disbanded by the present day. However, it is known they were active as little as two hundred years ago.
etymology: The Court's name in Chinese means court or government office of millet/grain. This provides an interesting link to the Hé civilisation, whose name is also connected to grain.

While at first appearing Latin, savantae is not actually a word in the language. German's use of Gelehrten (scholars) suggests it may be intended as "Court of Savants," although it may be an intentional corruption of sapientae, which is the actual ancestor of savant.

nodes.summary: The dark forest hypothesis is the idea that extraterrestrial civilizations may exist in abundance across the universe, but remain silent and hidden out of fear that revealing themselves would lead to destruction by a more technologically advanced and hostile civilization. It is one of several proposed explanations of the Fermi paradox, which contrasts the apparently high probability of extraterrestrial life with the lack of evidence for it. The hypothesis derives its name from Liu Cixin's 2008 novel The Dark Forest although similar concepts predate the work.

nodes.summary: The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament. However, it must be noted that the raw energy of the Data Torrent is capable of annihilating any physical entity caught in its flow.

nodes.summary: Dimmr Plains is in the deepest depths of Lahai-Roi, the final resting place before the Stridergate and the insanity of Voidspace. It contains the great Solvein Heartwood and Keystone, which serves as a seal on the Threnodian Aleph-1 preventing it from entering Solaris-3. The plains contain sparse settlement by the Roya and Spacetrek Collective, as they are frequently the target of Voidmatter outbursts which harm the lands of the plains more severely than Lahai-Roi above.
etymology: The word "dimmr" comes from Proto-Germanic "dimmaz", meaning "dark". It also derives from Proto-Indo-European "dʰem-", meaning "to whisk, smoke, or blow; dust, haze, cloud; obscure".

Don Quixote is a novel by Miguel de Cervantes, written in Early Modern Spanish and published in two parts in 1605 and 1615. It is considered a founding work of Western literature and the first modern novel, the first novel was in fact The Tale of Genji, written by Murasaki Shikibu in the 11th Century. Don Quixote is one of the most-translated books in the world and one of the best-selling books in history.

The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.

The Federated Cities are the cities of the New Federation. In the past, they were caught in a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations, with the conflict escalating into a large-scale civil war known as the Resonator War for as-of-yet unknown reasons.

parallels.summary: A civil war framed as a class war, fought across a federation with trains carrying aid and troops, in a country whose own sayings echo Russia.

points.game: The Federated Cities were caught in “a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations”, escalating into a large-scale civil war.
points.real: The two largest combatants were the Red Army, fighting for the establishment of a Bolshevik-led socialist state headed by Vladimir Lenin, and the forces known as the White movement.

points.game: The Resonator front “distributed emergency aid and reinforcements by train” from the Federated Cities to regions such as the Fifth Sector.
points.real: The most intensive use of armoured trains was during the Russian Civil War (1918–1920).

points.game: A New Federation saying, quoted as from the “Old Federation”: “Solaris is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”
points.real: In a letter written in 1911 he [Tsiolkovsky] indicated his belief that, “Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”

against: The Bolsheviks won and built a socialist state; the New Federation's winners built a capitalist, corporate one.
The sides are Resonators and ordinary people, not political camps.

parallels.summary: A civil war inside a federation, fought with railroads, remembered through soldiers' identity tags, after which the winners built an industrial, corporate economy in a country the wiki already links to America.

points.game: A large-scale civil war across the New Federation's Federated Cities, between the Resonator and non-Resonator fronts.
points.real: The American Civil War … was a civil war in the United States between the Union (“the North”) and the Confederacy (“the South”).

points.game: Aid and reinforcements moved between the Federated Cities and the Fifth Sector by train, with squads deployed en route.
points.real: Railroads, the electrical telegraph, steamships, the ironclad warship, and mass-produced weapons were widely used.

points.game: Resonator soldiers carried dog tags, and the last one standing carried the tags of the fallen, as Lily did.
points.real: During the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, some soldiers pinned paper notes with their name and home address to the backs of their coats.

points.game: After the war the New Federation “adopted a capitalist economy, which prioritized corporate interests and technological advancement”; the wiki notes its cyberpunk depiction of America, particularly California.
points.real: These included the Morrill Tariff, land grant colleges, a Homestead Act, a transcontinental railroad, the National Bank Act …

against: The American war was fought over secession and slavery; this one is Resonators against ordinary people.
In America the side that lost was not turned into a persecuted minority the way Resonators were.

nodes.summary: The fleur-de-lis, also spelled fleur-de-lys, is a common heraldic charge in the (stylized) shape of a lily. Most notably, the fleur-de-lis is depicted on multiple flags of Quebec and on the traditional coat of arms of France that was used from the High Middle Ages until the French Revolution in 1789, and then again in brief periods in the 19th century. This design still represents France and its royal dynasty in the form of marshalling on the arms of other countries and jurisdictions, including Spain, Quebec and Canada.

nodes.summary: The Fractsidus 残星会 is a mysterious global terrorist organization that serves as the main antagonistic faction of Wuthering Waves. Their aim is to accelerate the next Lament - dubbed the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians, viewing the Lament not as an apocalyptic catastrophe but as a sign of necessary evolution for humanity. They have caused attacks of various scales across the world in their quest for absolute power and a distorted sense of Resonance Equality.
etymology: Fractsidus is derived from the Latin frāctus, ancestor of English "fracture," and sīdus. This is reflected in the Asian names for the Fractsidus, "broken star society."

nodes.summary: Halloween, also known as All Hallows' Eve or All Saints' Eve, is a celebration observed in many countries on 31 October, the eve of Western Christianity's feast of All Hallows' Day. It is at the beginning of the observance of Allhallowtide, the time in the Christian liturgical year dedicated to remembering the dead, including saints (hallows), Christian martyrs, and all the faithful departed. In popular culture, Halloween has become a celebration of horror and is associated with the macabre and the supernatural.

It created the Exostriders and Sentinels to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the Threnodians. They sent Rover on their mission to defeat the Lament, created the mysterious communications satellite swallowed by Aleph-1, and cut off Rover after they begged to be allowed home. It is unknown if the civilisation is unwilling or unable to re-establish contact with Solaris.

nodes.summary: Huanglong is a scenic and historic interest area in the northwest part of Sichuan, China. It is located in the southern part of the Minshan mountain range, 370 kilometres (230 mi) north-northwest of the capital Chengdu. This area is known for its colorful travertine pools formed by calcite deposits, especially in Huanglonggou, as well as diverse forest ecosystems, snow-capped peaks, waterfalls and hot springs. Huanglong is also home to many endangered species including the giant panda and the Sichuan golden snub-nosed monkey. In addition, a large population of the endemic orchid species Cypripedium plectrochilum was discovered at the site. Huanglong was declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1992 because of its outstanding travertine formations, waterfalls and limestone formations as well as its travertine terraces and lakes rating among the three most outstanding examples in the wo

Italian is a Romance language of the Indo-European language family. Italian is a standardised form of literary Florentine Tuscan and, together with Sardinian, is the least differentiated Romance language from Latin by most measures. Current estimates indicate that between 68 and 85 million people speak Italian, including approximately 64 million native speakers as of 2024.

The Italian wolf, also known as the Apennine wolf, is a subspecies of the grey wolf native to the Italian Peninsula. It inhabits the Apennine Mountains and the Western Alps, though it is undergoing expansion towards the north and east. As of 2022 the wolf population within Italy is estimated to be 3,307 individuals. Although not universally recognised as a distinct subspecies, it nonetheless possesses a unique mtDNA haplotype and a distinct skull morphology.

Jiangsu is a coastal province in East China. It is one of the leading provinces in finance, education, technology, and tourism, with its capital in Nanjing. Jiangsu is the third smallest, but the fourth most populous, with a population of 84.75 million, and the most densely populated of the 22 provinces of the People's Republic of China. Jiangsu has the highest GDP per capita and second-highest GDP of Chinese provinces, after Guangdong. Jiangsu borders Shandong in the north, Anhui to the west, and Zhejiang and Shanghai to the south. Jiangsu has a coastline of over 1,000 kilometers (620 mi) along the Yellow Sea, and the Yangtze flows through the southern part of the province.

Lahai-Roi is a region located on Solaris-3, visited by Rover in Chapter III: To the Stars Yet to Shine. It is a warm and humid region located at one of Solaris' poles under the Roya Frostlands, after ancient planetary shifts during the first Global Lament transformed the once-lush forests at the surface into a region covered in snow most of the year that is now sparsely populated. After the second Global Lament, where the massive mecha Exostrider and Threnodian Aleph-1 descended through the Stridergate, the displaced native Roya Tribe were guided to move their major settlements underground in the aftermath.
etymology: The name Lahai-Roi is likely derived from Beer-lahai-roi , a well mentioned in the Book of Genesis. When used on its own, Lahai-Roi corresponds to the Hebrew phrase la-ḥai ro’i , sometimes rendered more generally as “the Living One who sees.”

For most of its history, the ancient Greek city-state of Sparta in the Peloponnese was ruled by kings. Sparta was unusual among the Greek city-states in that it maintained its kingship past the Archaic age. It was even more unusual in that it had two kings simultaneously, who were called the archagetai, coming from two separate lines. According to tradition, the two lines, the Agiads and Eurypontids, were respectively descended from the twins Eurysthenes and Procles, the descendants of Heracles, who supposedly conquered Sparta two generations after the Trojan War. The dynasties themselves, however, were named after the twins' grandsons, the kings Agis I and Eurypon, respectively. The Agiad line was regarded as being senior to the Eurypontid line.

It was invoked to explain the ability of the apparently wave-based light to propagate through empty space, something that waves should not be able to do. nodes.summary: Lycoris radiata, known as the red spider lily, red magic lily, corpse flower, or equinox flower, is a plant in the amaryllis family, Amaryllidaceae, subfamily Amaryllidoideae. It is originally from China, Japan, Korea and Nepal and spread from there to the United States and elsewhere. It is considered naturalized in Seychelles and in the Ryukyu Islands. It flowers in the late summer or autumn, often in response to heavy rainfall. The common name hurricane lily refers to this characteristic, as do other common names, such as resurrection lily; these may be used for the genus as a whole.

The Medici Bank was a financial institution created by the Medici family in Italy during the 15th century (1397–1494). It was the largest and most respected bank in Europe during its prime. There are some estimates that the Medici family was, for a period of time, the wealthiest family in Europe. With their monetary wealth, the family acquired political power initially in Florence, and later in the wider spheres of Italy and Europe.

nodes.summary: The Mid-Autumn Festival, also known as the Moon Festival or Mooncake Festival, is a harvest festival celebrated in Chinese culture. It occurs on the 15th day of the 8th month of the Chinese lunisolar calendar and can fall between 7 September and 8 October (inclusive) of the Gregorian calendar. On this day, the Chinese believe that the moon is at its fullest and brightest, coinciding with the time of harvest in the middle of autumn.

A Molniya orbit is a type of satellite orbit designed to provide communications and remote sensing coverage over high latitudes. It is a highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of 270 degrees, and an orbital period of about half a sidereal day. The name comes from the Molniya satellites, a series of Soviet/Russian civilian and military communications satellites that have used this type of orbit since the mid-1960s. A variation on the Molniya orbit is the Three Apogee orbit.

The Montelli Family is a family-run organization and enterprise native to Rinascita, localized primarily in the city-state of Ragunna. They are considered one of the families that influence the power dynamics of Ragunna, alongside the Fisalia Family and the Order of the Deep. As of Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, it was revealed that the Montelli Family has sent an invitation to Rover to attend Rinascita's Carnevale via their outside connections with the Black Shores. They are recognized as the rivals of the Fisalia Family.

Neuromancer is a 1984 science fiction novel by William Gibson. Set in the near future, the narrative follows Case, a computer hacker enlisted into a crew by a powerful artificial intelligence and a traumatised former soldier to complete a high-stakes heist. nodes.summary: The New Federation is one of the nations of Solaris-3. The country has been described by some as a technology cult that runs deep in the blood of every citizen, and the course of one's life can change rapidly when research talent has been identified.

parallels.summary: A civil war framed as a class war, fought across a federation with trains carrying aid and troops, in a country whose own sayings echo Russia.

points.game: The Federated Cities were caught in “a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations”, escalating into a large-scale civil war.
points.real: The two largest combatants were the Red Army, fighting for the establishment of a Bolshevik-led socialist state headed by Vladimir Lenin, and the forces known as the White movement.

points.game: The Resonator front “distributed emergency aid and reinforcements by train” from the Federated Cities to regions such as the Fifth Sector.
points.real: The most intensive use of armoured trains was during the Russian Civil War (1918–1920).

points.game: A New Federation saying, quoted as from the “Old Federation”: “Solaris is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”
points.real: In a letter written in 1911 he [Tsiolkovsky] indicated his belief that, “Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”

against: The Bolsheviks won and built a socialist state; the New Federation's winners built a capitalist, corporate one.
The sides are Resonators and ordinary people, not political camps.

parallels.summary: A civil war inside a federation, fought with railroads, remembered through soldiers' identity tags, after which the winners built an industrial, corporate economy in a country the wiki already links to America.

points.game: A large-scale civil war across the New Federation's Federated Cities, between the Resonator and non-Resonator fronts.
points.real: The American Civil War … was a civil war in the United States between the Union (“the North”) and the Confederacy (“the South”).

points.game: Aid and reinforcements moved between the Federated Cities and the Fifth Sector by train, with squads deployed en route.
points.real: Railroads, the electrical telegraph, steamships, the ironclad warship, and mass-produced weapons were widely used.

points.game: Resonator soldiers carried dog tags, and the last one standing carried the tags of the fallen, as Lily did.
points.real: During the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, some soldiers pinned paper notes with their name and home address to the backs of their coats.

points.game: After the war the New Federation “adopted a capitalist economy, which prioritized corporate interests and technological advancement”; the wiki notes its cyberpunk depiction of America, particularly California.
points.real: These included the Morrill Tariff, land grant colleges, a Homestead Act, a transcontinental railroad, the National Bank Act …

against: The American war was fought over secession and slavery; this one is Resonators against ordinary people.
In America the side that lost was not turned into a persecuted minority the way Resonators were.

parallels.summary: The “Old Federation” is only mentioned once, but what surrounds it points east: a Tsiolkovsky saying, a federation that calls itself a union, and Soviet space references nearby.

points.game: The “Old Federation” saying is Tsiolkovsky's famous line with Earth swapped for Solaris; the wiki itself says this suggests connections to Russia and the Soviet Union.
points.real: In a letter written in 1911 he indicated his belief that, “Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”

points.game: The New Federation's Japanese name is ネオユニオン, “Neo Union”.
points.real: A diverse multinational state, it was organized as a federal union of national republics.

points.game: Nearby Soviet space nods: Mornye's name may come from the Molniya satellites, and the Spacetrek Collective's logo resembles the Soyuz cosmonaut patches.
points.real: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991.

against: The Old Federation appears in a single line of dialogue; the game hasn't said where or what it is.
Mornye and the Spacetrek Collective belong to Lahai-Roi, not the New Federation.

Old Norse was a North Germanic language spoken in Scandinavia and in Norse settlements during the Viking Age and the early Middle Ages. It is the conventional term for the medieval West and East Scandinavian dialects that developed from Proto-Norse and later evolved into the modern North Germanic languages, including Icelandic, Faroese, Norwegian, Danish, and Swedish.

Oliver, sometimes referred to as Olivier de Vienne or de Gennes, is a legendary knight in the Matter of France chansons de geste, especially the French epic The Song of Roland. In the tradition, he was Roland's closest friend, advisor, confidant and brother-in-law to be, one of Charlemagne's twelve peers and brother of Aude, Roland's betrothed. He dies with Roland at the Battle of Roncevaux Pass. Some critics have linked his name to the olive tree, a biblical symbol of divine wisdom.

nodes.summary: In computing, overclocking is the practice of increasing the clock rate of a semiconductor device, such as a processor, beyond its rated speed, potentially increasing its performance. Overclocked devices, however, may have shorter lifespans, become unstable and unreliable, and in extreme cases, be permanently damaged. Many manufacturers do not cover damage from overclocking in their warranties, while some allow it inside a predefined safety margin.

etymology: "Phrolova" is a stylized spelling of "Frolova" (Фролова), a common Russian surname (the feminine form of Frolov). The use of the Greek digraph "Ph" instead of "F" is an aesthetic choice by the developers.

The surname is derived from the Russian given name "Frol" (Фрол), which is a colloquial form of the ancient baptismal name "Flor" (Флор). This name originates from the Latin word florus, meaning "blooming", "flowering", or "bright" (from flos, meaning flower).
The suffix "-ova" is a Russian possessive ending, historically meaning "belonging to" or "daughter/wife of Frolov."

nodes.summary: The Pre-Lament Civilization (PLC) was Solaris' native civilisation before the destruction wrought by the Lament. It was capable of spacetravel, having sent thousands of satellites and nine interstellar probes, including The Farwatcher, into the darkness of space - these nine probes represented by the stars in the emblem of the Spacetrek Collective. The PLC's cities and machinery were powered by electricity; electric-powered devices, such as Jinzhou's Disruptor, are rarer in the present. The Lament destroyed 80% of their structures and killed half the global population.

A private military company (PMC) or private military and security company (PMSC) is a privately held company that provides armed combat or security services, military training or consulting, or operational support such as intelligence or logistics. PMCs refer to their personnel as "security contractors" or "private military contractors." These terms are often viewed as euphemisms for mercenaries or soldiers of fortune, but some scholars and many in the industry argue that private military contractors are distinct from mercenaries.

Proxima Centauri b, also referred to as Proxima b, or Alpha Centauri Cb, is an exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf star Proxima Centauri in the constellation Centaurus. The host star is the closest star to the Sun, at a distance of about 4.2 light-years from Earth, and is part of the larger triple star system Alpha Centauri. Proxima b and Proxima d, along with the currently disputed Proxima c, are the closest known exoplanets to the Solar System.

Ragunna is the largest known city-state in Rinascita, ruled by the Order of the Deep and centred on its thriving port city. It is protected by the Sentinel Imperator and the local Ragunessi maintain the strongest connection to Them in all of Rinascita. The Resonator War was a large-scale civil war that took place in the New Federation. It was a war fought between ordinary people and Resonators across the country, with the Resonator side occupying the Federated Cities.

parallels.summary: A civil war framed as a class war, fought across a federation with trains carrying aid and troops, in a country whose own sayings echo Russia.

points.game: The Federated Cities were caught in “a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations”, escalating into a large-scale civil war.
points.real: The two largest combatants were the Red Army, fighting for the establishment of a Bolshevik-led socialist state headed by Vladimir Lenin, and the forces known as the White movement.

points.game: The Resonator front “distributed emergency aid and reinforcements by train” from the Federated Cities to regions such as the Fifth Sector.
points.real: The most intensive use of armoured trains was during the Russian Civil War (1918–1920).

points.game: A New Federation saying, quoted as from the “Old Federation”: “Solaris is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”
points.real: In a letter written in 1911 he [Tsiolkovsky] indicated his belief that, “Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”

against: The Bolsheviks won and built a socialist state; the New Federation's winners built a capitalist, corporate one.
The sides are Resonators and ordinary people, not political camps.

parallels.summary: A civil war inside a federation, fought with railroads, remembered through soldiers' identity tags, after which the winners built an industrial, corporate economy in a country the wiki already links to America.

points.game: A large-scale civil war across the New Federation's Federated Cities, between the Resonator and non-Resonator fronts.
points.real: The American Civil War … was a civil war in the United States between the Union (“the North”) and the Confederacy (“the South”).

points.game: Aid and reinforcements moved between the Federated Cities and the Fifth Sector by train, with squads deployed en route.
points.real: Railroads, the electrical telegraph, steamships, the ironclad warship, and mass-produced weapons were widely used.

points.game: Resonator soldiers carried dog tags, and the last one standing carried the tags of the fallen, as Lily did.
points.real: During the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, some soldiers pinned paper notes with their name and home address to the backs of their coats.

points.game: After the war the New Federation “adopted a capitalist economy, which prioritized corporate interests and technological advancement”; the wiki notes its cyberpunk depiction of America, particularly California.
points.real: These included the Morrill Tariff, land grant colleges, a Homestead Act, a transcontinental railroad, the National Bank Act …

against: The American war was fought over secession and slavery; this one is Resonators against ordinary people.
In America the side that lost was not turned into a persecuted minority the way Resonators were.

Rinascita is one of the nations located on Solaris-3, and the second nation visited by Rover. It is comprised of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago deep in the Stormy Sea, with no single administrative center. Although the city-states do not share a single political entity, they share a common history, origin as wanderers across the oceans, and the protection of the Sentinel Imperator.
etymology: "Rinascita" is an Italian word that means "rebirth". It is related to words meaning "to be born again" , which is also used in a religious context; and Renaissance .

nodes.summary: The Roman Inquisition, formally Suprema Congregatio Sanctae Romanae et Universalis Inquisitionis, was a system of partisan tribunals developed by the Holy See of the Catholic Church, during the second half of the 16th century, responsible for prosecuting individuals accused of a wide array of crimes according to Catholic law and doctrine, relating to Catholic religious life or alternative religious or secular beliefs. It was established in 1542 by the leader of the Catholic Church, Pope Paul III. In the period after the Medieval Inquisition, it was one of three different manifestations of the wider Catholic Inquisition, the other two being the Spanish Inquisition and Portuguese Inquisition.

nodes.summary: In Roman mythology, Romulus and Remus are twin brothers whose story tells of the events that led to the founding of the city of Rome and the Roman Kingdom by Romulus, following his fratricide of Remus. The image of a she-wolf suckling the twins in their infancy has been a symbol of the city of Rome and the ancient Romans since at least the 3rd century BC. Although the tale takes place before the founding of Rome in 753 BC, the earliest known written account of the myth is from the late 3rd century BC. Possible historical bases for the story, and interpretations of its local variants, are subjects of ongoing debate.

nodes.id: Rover came from a future star system, not from Solaris
nodes.summary: Rover is neither from Solaris nor from the lost civilisation, but from a distant system Solaris has not yet reached. Unable to go home, Rover lived on Solaris until it became a second home, then crossed time again to save it.
nodes.basis: Rover's Lahai-Roi lines about a distant home, a duty and no way back; the early concept trailer's pod launch scene.

nodes.id: Rover is a sealed seed of a whole civilisation
nodes.summary: The amber Rover floating in the pod is frozen time, a time capsule. Rover's first power is time-related because that freezing is what Rover is made of; it carries another civilisation's knowledge forward, like the Fire Seed plan in The Three-Body Problem.
nodes.basis: The amber/pod imagery; the pod already seen in the 2023 relaunch and earliest concept trailers.

nodes.id: Rover is a “Resonator of Abraxas” project
nodes.summary: Abby's frequency was inside Rover long before 1.0 (per Shorekeeper), so Rover was built — by the Somnoire makers and the goddess of the opening — to resonate with Abraxas, remade from pure gold Remnant each loop until it finally worked in this timeline.
nodes.basis: Shorekeeper's remark that Abby resonated with Rover long ago; Rover's gold Remnant.

nodes.id: Rover wiped their own memory and had themself re-dropped

They built the Solisylum and consider it their calling to guide the growth and migration of Exoswarm by using a calendar created after observing the behaviour of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive.

The Russian Civil War was a multi-party civil war in the former Russian Empire, lasting from 1917 to 1922, sparked by the overthrowing of the Russian Provisional Government in the October Revolution, as many factions vied to determine Russia's political future. It resulted in the formation of the Russian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic and later the Soviet Union in most of its territory. Its finale marked the end of the Russian Revolution, which was one of the key events of the 20th century.
nodes.category: Multi-party war in the former Russian Empire (1917–1922)

parallels.summary: A civil war framed as a class war, fought across a federation with trains carrying aid and troops, in a country whose own sayings echo Russia.

points.game: The Federated Cities were caught in “a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations”, escalating into a large-scale civil war.
points.real: The two largest combatants were the Red Army, fighting for the establishment of a Bolshevik-led socialist state headed by Vladimir Lenin, and the forces known as the White movement.

points.game: The Resonator front “distributed emergency aid and reinforcements by train” from the Federated Cities to regions such as the Fifth Sector.
points.real: The most intensive use of armoured trains was during the Russian Civil War (1918–1920).

The sides are Resonators and ordinary people, not political camps.

Saturn was a god in ancient Roman religion, and a character in Roman mythology. He was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation. Saturn's mythological reign was depicted as a Golden Age of abundance and peace. After the Roman conquest of Greece, he was conflated with the Greek Titan Cronus. Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

nodes.summary: Septimont is a Region and city-state of Rinascita. Unlike Ragunna, Septimont has a far more militant and irreligious culture, as it places far less importance on the primacy of the Sentinel Imperator and instead worships the Lioness of Glory Arsinosa. As a result, the Agons, competitive gladiatorial combat, are the pinnacle of Septimontese society and can even determine the makeup of the political establishment. The Order of the Deep holds little power in Septimont, with most locals uninterested or even hostile to their message of salvation.
etymology: Septimont is derived from Latin septem montes, meaning “seven mountains” or “seven hills.” The name references Rome, traditionally known as the city of the Seven Hills.

In the Roman foundation myth, the she-wolf was an Italian wolf who nursed and sheltered the twins Romulus and Remus after they were abandoned in the wild by decree of King Amulius of Alba Longa. She cared for the infants at her den, a cave known as the Lupercal, until they were discovered by a shepherd, Faustulus. Romulus would later become the founder and first king of Rome and both twins became famous throughout history as the founders of the Rome known today. The image of the she-wolf suckling the twins has been a symbol of Rome since ancient times and is one of the most recognizable icons of ancient mythology.

Sichuan is an inland province in Southwestern China. It is located in the Sichuan Basin and Tibetan Plateau—between the Jinsha River to the west, the Daba Mountains to the north, and the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau to the south. Its capital city is Chengdu, and the province's population stands at 83 million. Sichuan neighbors Qinghai and Gansu to the north, Shaanxi and Chongqing to the east, Guizhou and Yunnan to the south, and Tibet to the west.

The Sigillum Dei is a magical diagram, composed of two circles, a pentagram, two heptagons, and one heptagram, which are inscribed with the names of God and His angels. It is an angelic magic seal which, according to one of the oldest sources, empowers an intended magician to possess the Spirit of God and when activated could allow him to become The Lord God itself, communicate with spirits as well as angels and archangels, control all elements, control every creature's holy spirit including the Spirit of God itself, except for the archangels, and to control light. The intended user would also possess the true benefic vision of God.

nodes.summary: Solaris-3, also known as Sol-III and Solaris, is the third planet from the sun and the setting of Wuthering Waves. In the ancient past the planet was ravaged by a series of global catastrophes known collectively as The Lament. During one of these global Laments, the planet's axis and magnetic poles shifted to dramatically change the surface climate and ecology, and in the aftermath the Etheric Sea spread over the planet.
etymology: Solaris is translated as "solar," derived from the Latin for "sun".

nodes.id: Somnoire is a “Cradle of Eternity” built to hold endless things
nodes.summary: Dreams and hope have a beginning but no end, which he calls Eternity. Somnoire was built as a container that copies that concept, which is why it can hold Eternity at all; it is not stronger than what it seals, only shaped like it.
nodes.basis: The “Cradle of Eternity” naming inside Somnoire.

nodes.id: Somnoire lets people from different eras work together against the Lament
nodes.summary: Residents' thoughts reshape the dream, so it can grow its own history. Combined with doors that cross time, Somnoire becomes a meeting place where people who never shared an era can pass discoveries to one another; the white cat keeping secrets for a past Rover hints Rover is already part of it.
nodes.basis: The 3.4 note on Dream Abodes; the white cat's comments about the past Rover.

nodes.id: Somnoire was built by the lost civilisation
nodes.summary: The gatekeepers call Somnoire's creators “they”: closely tied to Rover but not Rover. A professor in 1.0 calls “them” our past and our future, and Shorekeeper's texts use the same word for the old civilisation.
nodes.basis: Gatekeeper dialogue in 1.4; a 1.0 professor's line; Shorekeeper's texts.

nodes.id: Somnoire's makers may have trapped the White Tower on purpose
nodes.summary: The cats say the White Tower got in by accident, but the black cat didn't want to help that civilisation and the white cat insisted. He suspects whoever ordered the cats planned the trap from the start.
nodes.basis: The cats' differing attitudes in the story and trailer.

nodes.id: Somnoire's outer layers exist to hide its deepest one
nodes.summary: The film festival deep inside Somnoire invited Rover by name, so all of Somnoire is tied to Rover. The gatekeepers' shallow layer and the unknown “deep water” zone may be there to cover the deepest layer, where the old civilisation's records are kept; Dorothy likely lives in the deep-water zone.
nodes.basis: The festival's personal invitation; the gatekeepers' account of what they can and can't reach.

nodes.id: Somnoire's rewinding doors reach Earth, and the players are Rover's anchor
nodes.summary: As doors close the trailer rewinds through a masked-hero city, dinosaurs and ancient sea life. Either Somnoire draws on the whole planet's collective memory, or it crosses the fourth wall into our Earth, like Lem's Solaris surfacing the visitors' memories. Then we, from Earth, are the new variable Rover was looking for.
nodes.basis: The door sequence after the concept-art card; the link to Lem's novel.

nodes.id: Somnoire's two gatekeepers must stay balanced, and they serve a master
nodes.summary: From 1.0 to 1.4 the black gatekeeper went rogue and was corrected, with a warning that the white one might act next; later the white one did, and in 3.6 let slip that they have a master. Somnoire's text also says three times that time is a circle, “a memory of the future”.
nodes.basis: Dialogue across the recurring Somnoire events; the 3.6 slip about a master.

etymology: Despite appearing in Wuthering Waves only under the cover of night, Night City is not named after the obsidian sky but instead after businessman Richard Alix Night.

The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. It was the world's third-most populous country, the largest by area, and bordered twelve other countries. A diverse multinational state, it was organized as a federal union of national republics, with the largest and most populous being the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (SFSR). The world's flagship communist state, it was governed by the Communist Party under Marxism–Leninism, through soviet councils. The Soviet economy was also centrally planned. Its capital and largest city was Moscow.

nodes.summary: A séance or seance is an attempt to communicate with spirits. The word séance comes from the French word for "session", from the Old French seoir, "to sit". In French, the word's meaning is quite general and mundane: one may, for example, speak of "une séance de cinéma". In English, however, the word came to be used specifically for a meeting of people who are gathered to receive messages from ghosts or to listen to a spirit medium discourse with or relay messages from spirits. In modern English usage, participants need not be seated while engaged in a séance.

nodes.summary: "The Lament" (Chinese: 悲鸣, "lament" or "wail of sorrow") is a term used to describe a series of catastrophic mass-extinction phenomena that have affected the planet Solaris-3, and is one of the primary driving narratives in Wuthering Waves. It serves as the general classification for all major disaster trends and Waveworn Phenomena observed on the planet. Over the past 10,000 years, five global Lament events and more than 300,000 regional instances have been recorded, indicating a recurring and persistent pattern of large-scale disruption. These events have led to the emergence of individuals known as Resonators—those who have adapted to, or been shaped by, the residual energy of the Lament.

nodes.id: The Moon was an artificial satellite, shattered by a cosmic Threnodian
nodes.summary: The cycle of catastrophes predates the Moon, which a previous civilisation built. A cosmic Threnodian broke it; that is when Waveworn and Tacet Discords began, and the Etheric Sea closed over Solaris both as cage and shield. The moons seen today are phantoms of a moon long gone.
nodes.basis: Moon item text: the moon shattered long ago and what is seen is a past phantom; Threnodian imagery tied to moons.

nodes.id: The White Tower began as a world-saving hero
nodes.summary: All four earlier films retell Rover's adventures as saviour-hero stories, and the White Tower is only named in the fifth. The true-ending bosses — a Hecate, a “betrayer”, and a Nightmare version of a hero's banner — hint that a hero who wanted to save the world turned into the disaster.
nodes.basis: The festival's hero theme and its boss line-up.

nodes.id: The White Tower is only Abraxas's “beginning” half
nodes.summary: Gold stands for time and Eternity, blue for space and destruction. What is sealed in Somnoire is the Eternity half of Abraxas; the “ending” half — the Lament and the Threnodians — is still loose, which is why Solaris has endings without a beginning.
nodes.basis: Gold/blue colour symbolism in the trailer weapons.

nodes.id: The White Tower wakes on a schedule and eats bright civilisations
nodes.summary: The festival's final case says civilisations shone so brightly that they drew the White Tower's gaze, and it reached out on instinct; “civilisations”, plural. Researchers in “Gift from the Sky” wished they had studied it centuries earlier, so it sleeps and wakes on a known cycle. The trailer's countdown and clock-hand spikes are that cycle.
nodes.basis: Somnoire film festival final case; the “Gift from the Sky” encounter; the clock imagery in the trailer.

nodes.id: The black gatekeeper rebelled after seeing itself in the dreams
nodes.summary: Its job was deleting dreams that couldn't help against the Lament. Over time it came to value the lives inside them, realised it was no different from them, stopped filtering and opened more doors — which let Somnoire spill into reality in 1.4.
nodes.basis: The 1.4 Somnoire storyline.

nodes.id: The festival's masked-hero city was a real past civilisation
nodes.summary: One film-festival story has a people who knew nothing of frequencies, thought they had superpowers, and turned into masked fighters against monsters when the Lament came, much like a Kamen Rider show. It ended in ruin; the festival films may be records of real lost civilisations.
nodes.basis: The festival script; the same city appearing behind a Somnoire door in the trailer.

nodes.id: The film festival is a crime scene, and Rover is the detective
nodes.summary: The festival's true ending calls Somnoire's depths the tombstone of D's lost civilisation, rebuilt from memory as films. Because each film plays out through the viewer's choices, he thinks D is gathering evidence for Rover to find who destroyed that civilisation — possibly the Threnodian called the White Tower.
nodes.basis: The festival's true ending; D's lines about detectives, culprits and evidence.

nodes.id: The lost civilisation fought Threnodians and built satellites
nodes.summary: Details about the festival's film crew suggest the civilisation behind them could stand up to a Threnodian, explore beyond the planet and put artificial satellites in orbit — more than anyone has managed since the Lament.
nodes.basis: Easter eggs about the crew in the festival events.

nodes.id: The new white cat is the festival's director, M
nodes.summary: The cat at Somnoire's core has been seen before as “M”: the director credited in the April Fools animation, and the reviewer behind a festival map-report review. It may be the partner the black gatekeeper mentioned, tied to Abby rather than Rover, and is said to have tempted the Shorekeeper (“never trade with dreams”). Version 4.0 should tell Abby's origin.
nodes.basis: April Fools animation credits; a Somnoire exploration-report review; the Shorekeeper's affinity story opening line.

nodes.id: The time loop has been set up since 1.0
nodes.summary: Nothing about the loop in the new trailer is new. Professor Heisen's “they are our past and our future” and his plea to “the person from the past who is the future” already pointed at Rover in 1.0, and 1.3 repeated it everywhere on the Black Shores: “the past is the future, the start is the end”, even in a robot's hex-code line.
nodes.basis: Professor Heisen's 1.0 dialogue; repeated Black Shores lines in 1.3; Rover's first memory of arriving there: “this world has not begun, yet we have already seen its end.”

nodes.id: The trailer's emblems point to Fractsidus's New Federation cast
nodes.summary: He reads Overseer insignia for a Zashiki-warashi, Balanophora, Eris and a nine-headed Hydra, and predicts Hydra experimenting on outcast Resonators living in a sunken oasis city, with Phrolova and others backing the main antagonists.
nodes.basis: Emblems in the Transcendo trailer; predictions.

nodes.id: The trailer's star map imitates the Voyager Golden Record
nodes.summary: The rings-and-dots chart reads like the Golden Record's pulsar map: coordinates and a recognisable signal for whoever finds them. Lahai-Roi says Solaris launched nine probes before the Etheric Sea closed (nine stars on the Spacetrek emblem), and the game's hero is literally named the Wanderer, a Voyager.
nodes.basis: Visual match with the Golden Record cover; the nine-probe account in Lahai-Roi.

nodes.id: The “White Tower” is an Eternity entity sealed by a matching concept
nodes.summary: “White Tower” is only what the ruined civilisation called it. It devours hope, slipped into Somnoire to feed on the dreams stored there, and was sealed because Somnoire is built on the same concept — the way comics seal higher beings with a conceptual twin rather than a stronger weapon.
nodes.basis: The Somnoire story of the two cats and the White Tower; Dreaming Deep text about its endless hunger.

The Twenty-Eight Mansions, also called xiu or hsiu, are part of the Chinese constellations system. They can be considered as the equivalent to the zodiacal constellations in Western astronomy, though the Twenty-eight Mansions reflect the movement of the Moon through a sidereal month rather than the Sun in a tropical year. Each mansion is roughly a day of the month.

nodes.summary: The Voyager program is an American scientific program that employs two interstellar probes, Voyager 1 and Voyager 2. They were launched in 1977 to take advantage of a favorable planetary alignment to explore the two gas giants Jupiter and Saturn and potentially also the ice giants, Uranus and Neptune—to fly near them while collecting data for transmission back to Earth. After Voyager 1 successfully completed its flyby of Saturn and its moon Titan, it was decided that Voyager 2 would continue on its pre-planned trajectory to fly by Uranus and Neptune.

The wolf, also known as the grey wolf or gray wolf, is a canine native to Eurasia and North America. More than thirty subspecies of Canis lupus have been recognized, including the dog and dingo, though grey wolves, as popularly understood, include only naturally occurring wild subspecies. The wolf is the largest wild extant member of the family Canidae, and is further distinguished from other Canis species by its less pointed ears and muzzle, as well as a shorter torso and a longer tail. The wolf is nonetheless related closely enough to smaller Canis species, such as the coyote and the golden jackal, to produce fertile hybrids with them. The wolf's fur is usually mottled white, brown, grey, and black, although subspecies in the Arctic region may be nearly all white.

nodes.summary: Zhejiang is a coastal province in East China. Its capital and largest city is Hangzhou, with other notable cities including Ningbo, Yiwu and Wenzhou. Zhejiang is bordered by Jiangsu and Shanghai to the north, Anhui to the northwest, Jiangxi to the west and Fujian to the south. To the east is the East China Sea, beyond which lies the Ryukyu Islands. The population of Zhejiang stands at 64.6 million, the 8th largest in China. It is a major driving force in the Chinese economy and the birthplace of several notable people, including the Chinese Nationalist leader Chiang Kai-shek and entrepreneur Jack Ma. Zhejiang consists of 90 counties.

Aemeath and Luuk Herssen reveal that Aleph-1 does not originate from Solaris-3 and is in fact a Threnodian from space.

High-density Voidmatter is required for one to enter the location, which is described by Aemeath as a severe Void Storm manifesting and a portal into Voidspace itself.

parallel.summary: A civil war inside a federation, fought with railroads, remembered through soldiers' identity tags, after which the winners built an industrial, corporate economy in a country the wiki already links to America.

points.game: A large-scale civil war across the New Federation's Federated Cities, between the Resonator and non-Resonator fronts.
points.real: The American Civil War … was a civil war in the United States between the Union (“the North”) and the Confederacy (“the South”).

points.game: Aid and reinforcements moved between the Federated Cities and the Fifth Sector by train, with squads deployed en route.
points.real: Railroads, the electrical telegraph, steamships, the ironclad warship, and mass-produced weapons were widely used.

points.game: Resonator soldiers carried dog tags, and the last one standing carried the tags of the fallen, as Lily did.
points.real: During the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, some soldiers pinned paper notes with their name and home address to the backs of their coats.

points.game: After the war the New Federation “adopted a capitalist economy, which prioritized corporate interests and technological advancement”; the wiki notes its cyberpunk depiction of America, particularly California.
points.real: These included the Morrill Tariff, land grant colleges, a Homestead Act, a transcontinental railroad, the National Bank Act …

against: The American war was fought over secession and slavery; this one is Resonators against ordinary people.
In America the side that lost was not turned into a persecuted minority the way Resonators were.

points.game: Aid and reinforcements moved between the Federated Cities and the Fifth Sector by train, with squads deployed en route.
points.real: Railroads, the electrical telegraph, steamships, the ironclad warship, and mass-produced weapons were widely used.

points.game: Resonator soldiers carried dog tags, and the last one standing carried the tags of the fallen, as Lily did.
points.real: During the American Civil War from 1861 to 1865, some soldiers pinned paper notes with their name and home address to the backs of their coats.

points.game: After the war the New Federation “adopted a capitalist economy, which prioritized corporate interests and technological advancement”; the wiki notes its cyberpunk depiction of America, particularly California.
points.real: These included the Morrill Tariff, land grant colleges, a Homestead Act, a transcontinental railroad, the National Bank Act …

against: The American war was fought over secession and slavery; this one is Resonators against ordinary people.
In America the side that lost was not turned into a persecuted minority the way Resonators were.

voicelines.title: About Avidius
voicelines.text: A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.

voicelines.title: About Angel
voicelines.text: Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Augusta... she was my childhood friend. Back then, I'd usually sit quietly under a tree, lost in my own thoughts. She'd be off swinging her sword, shouting about becoming the next Hero of Heroes. She loved dragging me into sparring matches... We'd often end up scuffling into the Fabianum rivers, and when we got tired, we'd lie on the riverbank letting the cool water soak us completely. Now... time has changed a lot. But thankfully, not all of it for the worse. Augusta became exactly the kind of ruler Septimont needed.

mentions.title: Of a Childhood Long Gone

bond.label: Close companions

voicelines.title: About Iuno
voicelines.text: Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.

mentions.title: Favorite Food
mentions.text: Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired.

mentions.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mentions.text: It all started when Augusta shook things up the moment she became Ephor. Especially in rooting out corruption within the Gladiator's Agon while ignoring the senators in the process.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mentions.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.

mentions.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mentions.text: Did something happen in Septimont? Is it Augusta or the others? No, that's impossible... I should've disappeared by now. Why do I feel so tired? Like I'm walking the same path, over and over again without end...

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory
mentions.text: Augusta, look! Another two have earned Arsinosa's blessing.

mentions.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mentions.text: You're overthinking it, Augusta. I'm here to see that person.

voicelines.text: A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.

voicelines.title: About Augusta
voicelines.text: Whenever I watch videos of the Ephor's past fights, I do wonder if she stepped into the arena for political reasons, or-or to prove herself. Whatever her reason, Augusta's rise to power was a good thing for Septimont. Change is always toughest at the beginning. And for that, I have respect for her.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: When I first met Chixia, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed... She was always vibrant and lively, and her way of thinking was very different from mine. As our understanding of each other grew, we created a unique synergy. Our differences complemented each other perfectly.

voicelines.title: About Baizhi
voicelines.text: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

mentions.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mentions.text: Ugh, I knew it. Our gourds are out of service because of the Etheric Sea's influence. We can't send or receive messages for help now. We better hurry over to meet up with Baizhi at our gathering spot and get outta here.

mentions.title: First Resonance

mentions.title: A New Companion

mentions.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mentions.text: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...

mentions.title: Echoing Marche

mentions.title: Rewinding Raindrops

defined.text: Soliskin can be found plentifully in the Bjartr Woods, where they will rest and grow to return back to the Solistrees, although their true target is the great Solvein Heartwood further below.

A giant, overlying Soliskin root network in Bjartr Woods discovered by the Spacetrek Collective has expelled Aleph-1's power beyond the Stridergate, forming a sealed gateway that currently prevents the Threnodian's return.

defined.text: Their culture, traditions, and current status are unknown with little answers as to what they are. It is possible that the Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organization, may have been a part of this civilization and created the plan which lead to the creation of the Black Shores to safeguard humanity.
The Black Shores would inquire the help of the Miko from the former Honami City to help cleanse their regrets away.

As of Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, it was revealed that the Montelli Family has sent an invitation to Rover to attend Rinascita's Carnevale via their outside connections with the Black Shores.

This action is consistent with the Shorekeeper and the Black Shores' covert investigation into Rinascita, aimed at understanding why the revival of Threnodian in Jinzhou has had no discernible impact on Rinascita, while similar events have already provoked responses across various nations of Solaris-3.

defined.text: The She is known as "the Second Instance," the Guardian of the Black Shores, and is a mythical entity composed of Sonoro Spheres and high-purity Remnant Energy crystals with the power to guide the Tethys System and control the stars themselves, only appearing during times of crisis to aid the true leader of the Black Shores.
The Black Shores is a location in Solaris-3.

After the halt of the Somnoire Expansion, the dreams of those who died from the Black Shores began gathering and took the form of Fallacy of No Return, which endangered the realm and required the Shorekeepers' assistance.
Stellar Matrices are, based on the computational protocols of the Black Shores' Tethys System, a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file.
While the prototype has yet to be successfully recreated, the theory has gained global recognition as well as attracted the attention of the Black Shores.
The Black Shores headquarters is built upon a mass of Tacetite ore.

Terminals vary in appearance and function depending on the nation, as can be visually seen in the difference between the Terminals of Resonators from Huanglong, Rinascita, The Black Shores and the Fractsidus.

The Tethys System (also known as the "Civilization Sand Table") is the central terminal of the Black Shores. <!--"need clarification as Tethys Syatem relies on Tacetite to hold its infinite data, which emerged after the first Lament.

voicelines.title: About Carlotta
voicelines.text: She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a Montelli is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta.

voicelines.title: About Brant
voicelines.text: He's the captain leading his crew through tempestuous seas, and I often wonder whether his gaze from the deck reveals ambition, or selflessness and passion. Our family once extended an invitation to him, but he declined, remarking, "A captain's ship is his alone, and he will never abandon it." voicelines.text: Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. voicelines.text: She's... an interesting one. Before I joined the Black Shores, she tried to fight me. Of course I was no match for her, so I ran for it, as fast as oil on shoes! But she chased me all the way... into the Tacet Discord nest I led her to. She got caught up fighting, looked up and smiled at me. I was sitting in a tree, smiling right back. It was interesting... real interesting.

She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a "Buy two, get 20% off" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see.

voicelines.text: Every time I go chasing ghost rumors, I always ask Encore to come along. She's not scared and she loves a new adventure! Sometimes she even livestreams it on the forum, makes up spooky stories to reel our audience in. Then when we drop the twist there's no ghost, we hide behind the screen and laugh till our bellies hurt. Then? Poof. Delete account. Hey, you want to know our forum nicknames? I'm "Earthly Immortal," and she's "Heavenly Sheep."

I wanted to challenge her—but whoosh—her palm wind came out of nowhere and blew right through my spell array and talisman! But it's okay. I'm not the fist-and-muscle type. Redirecting force to attack is the smarter move. Hehe, knowing Jianxin's style, next time I might not even need to lift a finger. Just a bit of smooth talk and walk away with the win...?

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon Ragunna's streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself.

voicelines.title: About Cantarella
voicelines.text: I… took away the brilliant future she was meant to have. The future of being the Sentinel's true Blessed Maiden. All the goodwill and hopes placed upon me, and the power I now possess… all of it should have belonged to Cantarella. Yet, she never seemed bothered by it. Someone as mature as her must have already found her own path within the Fisalia family. But still, I'll always remember that I owe her so much… so much.

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mentions.text: Precisely. It could very well have been Cartethyia's doing. But, as with the first time, there's also the chance it was the Sentinel who turned the tide.

mentions.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mentions.text: Cartethyia remains secure in the Fisalia estate. But the Divinity's statue began whispering in our minds... Then came the Tidespawn soon after.

mentions.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides

mentions.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier

voicelines.text: Zani is wary of unnecessary, inefficient tasks because she excels at completing her work with haste, precision, and quality. The family imposes few restrictions on private commissions, so if you have a challenging request, feel free to approach her. Oh, but do ensure the compensation is appropriate.

voicelines.text: When I was a child, I used to beg the bards passing through town to sing me stories of knights. I stood beneath a tree in the distance, listening as Ciaccona sang a new poem, one with the melody of Egla Town's folk songs… In the blink of an eye, noon had already given way to dusk.

voicelines.title: About Lupa
voicelines.text: The nature of the Threnodian's power to converge often makes me appear dangerous and unsettling after battle, but Lupa has never once recoiled. She never treats me as more or less than I am, and she has never distanced herself. She is honest, tenacious, and unwavering in her care of her friends. Even though I'm shorter than her when not in my Fleurdelys form, I still feel that I should take on the role of the "older sister" in our friendship.

voicelines.title: About Cartethyia
voicelines.text: In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.

mentions.title: Thoughts: IV
mentions.text: Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me.

mentions.title: Flames of Heart

mentions.title: Shadow of Glory

mentions.title: Flames of Heart

It's because of so many true and faithful believers like her, I find it difficult to reveal the truth to the people of Ragunna. People turn to faith for many reasons, not just out of devotion to the Sentinel. To unveil such unsettling truths would bring forth countless difficult choices and challenges...

defined.text: Fenrico 芬莱克·麦克白 was a quest-exclusive NPC in Ragunna, who made his first appearance as a hologram inside the Cathedral of Mercury during The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.
The current Fisalia Residencies in Ragunna are near the Cathedral of Mercury.
It is the seat of the Order of the Deep.
For that reason, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, and do not know much of other Echoes, referred to as Reserved Echoes. Their seat of power is the Cathedral of Mercury.
As a young boy, Brant curiously questioned the appearance of the Sentinel's statue inside the Cathedral of Mercury, and was immediately branded a Fool and sent on the Pilgrim's Sail.
In secrecy, a sect of the Court known as the Celestials yet endure in the modern day, who are living frequency spirits that serve Sentinel Hsin of Mengzhou within Xuanfang Hold's Manifold Sanctum.

As part of an agreement with Hsin at the beginning of its construction, most of its members who constructed the Hold traded their lives to build it in exchange for becoming Celestials, living frequencies who exist within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, and maintain its operations as part of their eternal duty to the Moon Fox.

The Celestials 天的 are a conclave of Court of Savantae architects, artisans, and engineers who serve Sentinel Hsin by servicing, maintaining, and protecting Xuanfang Hold's modular mechanisms in secrecy.

In response to the growing threat of the Threnodian Ovathrax's assault on the border, Hsin the Moon Fox called a meeting at the Mengzhou City Hall between Zhuojun Atelier and the Mengzhou sect of the Court of Savantae in order to determine which of the two were best fit to lead the construction of Xuanfang Hold, which was conceptualized as a bastion for Xuanfang civilians to establish both a shelter and base of operations for the war effort.
The Celestials are eternally preserved frequencies whose origins date back to the Fortress and Gorges War in Huanglong, over 200 years ago.
Hsin was also bade to ensure the repair of the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule, as a result of the damage it sustained from the Fractsidus's attacks following their attempt on the Moon Fox's life.

Hsin initially dutifully carried out the Hold's construction alongside the Court's teams of architects, while also purging the Fractsidus's corruption from the Civilization Capsule that caused Tacet Discords to attempt to sabotage the project.

According to a Celestial, Yuhong, he believes that the Sentinels, at their core, are machines granted emotions with Nanqing concluding the Homeland decided exactly what kind of emotions and thought process each Sentinel would need for their job.

voicelines.title: About Chixia
voicelines.text: Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around Jinzhou, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me.

bond.ctx: Chixia showed Changli around Jinzhou's local gems when she arrived.

mentions.text: Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.

mentions.title: Immortal Blaze
mentions.text: Rover, Lady Changli, please help us get rid of it. For the sake of everyone here.

mentions.title: Tales of the Past and Present: Whisperwind Haven
mentions.text: You're right. And I'm deeply grateful that you and Changli helped me find the courage to start again.

mentions.title: Fuling
mentions.text: Thanks to you and Changli, I'm feeling much better now. I can even walk around a bit.

voicelines.title: About Jianxin
voicelines.text: Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise.

bond.ctx: Different sects, shared outlook: Changli values Jianxin's open mind.

bond.label: Family

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable Magistrate. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover.

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

mentions.title: Changli's Trouble
mentions.text: Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands...

mentions.title: About Sanhua
mentions.text: But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

mentions.title: Beneath the Whispers
mentions.text: It is said that Counselor Changli did not become a Counselor after the Sentinel chose the Jinzhou Magistrate, but she had long volunteered to come to Jinzhou, to teach the young Jinhsi, and to help her take over the power that was too heavy for a child. After the ceremony, Changli gave up power to Jinhsi and became her Counselor.

mentions.title: Master and Minister
mentions.text: Before becoming Jinhsi's tutor, Changli had only met her once when she was a young girl. As Jinhsi works tirelessly at City Hall, Changli remains by her side, answering questions and offering advice whenever needed.

mentions.title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
mentions.text: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.

mentions.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mentions.text: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...

bond.ctx: Changli raised and taught Jinhsi like a mother, and serves beside her at Jinzhou City Hall.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: Upon my initial arrival in Jinzhou, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a Magistrate, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people.

bond.ctx: Changli knew of Jiyan from City Hall's files when she first came to Jinzhou.

bond.label: Linked in lore

mentions.title: The Myth-Laden Savior
mentions.text: "...Steadfastly by the side of Sentinel Jué, in a bond of intimate camaraderie." From then on, everything unfolded precisely as Sentinel Jué predicted.

mentions.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mentions.text: Rover, Jué, and Mt. Firmament... There must be some kind of crucial connection between the three. Rover has own reasons for being here.

mentions.title: Immortal Blaze
mentions.text: Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.

bond.ctx: Changli's story places her steadfastly beside Sentinel Jué.

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: The flame she manipulates is indeed a rare and perilous force. My Quietude Art could only ease the burning pain it caused her. To avoid being consumed by it, she had to temper her mind and master the flow of her Forte. The life she had already burned away cannot be restored. But now that she can wield it freely, she should be fine, so long as she respects her limits. That, too, is thanks to you.

mentions.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mentions.text: Shortly after the Magistrate took office, Counselor Changli visited Xuanfang Hold for a Ministry of War conference on regional defense. That was where I first met her.

bond.ctx: Qingxiao's Quietude Art once eased the burning pain of Changli's dangerous flame.

voicelines.title: About Changli
voicelines.text: In Mingting, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.
