voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: Chisa is also from Ashinohara. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.

bond.ctx: Both from Ashinohara; Hiyuki avoids Chisa because Mikos are omens of dark times there.

mentions.text: Mm-hmm. During the years I was missing, they moved to Lahai-Roi and took up Academy positions offered by President Lucilla.

mentions.text: My side is progressing well too. President Lucilla's Void Storm reports came at the right moment.

mentions.title: We Choose the Sky
mentions.text: That's what's strange to me. But Professor Lucilla only had Rover come, so maybe it's not as serious as we think?

voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: First time I saw Chisa, I thought that quiet, intense vibe meant "keep your distance." Man, was I wrong. We clicked instantly. She took one look at my bike and knew exactly what part was malfunctioning. Way faster than any manual diagnostic I could've run! Now that's impressive...

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mentions.text: Sigrika! Over here! Chisa's getting a new top record!

mentions.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mentions.text: Unconventional methods, huh? That reminds me, just a few days ago, a student named Chisa appeared out of thin air in the middle of a class. Freaked everyone out.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Rover, I've been asking everyone. Even Lynae was being vague about it, but I figured it out…

bond.ctx: Lynae thought Chisa was distant; they clicked over her bike.
bond.textContext: 1 additional sourced passages; speaker and chapter are recorded below.

voicelines.title: About Chisa
voicelines.text: The freshman girl who vanished in the Void Storm... I remember the incident clearly. It happened during my first year as a teaching assistant at the Academy. I even graded a paper she submitted. It was exceptionally well-written, with a logical structure, rigorous analysis, and precise formatting. Now, she's become the student who writes the best papers in my class.

mentions.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mentions.text: Rover, I'm at the Research Institute. Professor Mornye is here, too.

bond.ctx: Mornye was a teaching assistant when freshman Chisa vanished in the Void Storm.

voicelines.title: About Namipon
voicelines.text: Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it.

mentions.title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
mentions.text: But here's what we do know: After the Lament, Namipon gained a physical form and a will of its own. And as Honami's mascot, it knows the city like the back of its paw. The layout, the pathways. I believe that makes it a pretty reliable partner.

mentions.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mentions.text: I just remembered... Namipon always said the cafe needed more life. Maybe now is the time to try?

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mentions.text: Last break, I made time to go back to Honami. Brought Namipon some Roya snacks. And Namipon said.. it really hopes you'll go back to visit.

mentions.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mentions.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

mentions.title: Stranger Things in Honami/Story
mentions.text: It's too soon to jump to conclusions. But the Meishin Passageway she mentioned is highly suspect… Has anyone reported strange happenings there, Namipon?

mentions.title: Star Bouncing · event story
mentions.text: I just... started to talk like Namipon.

defined.text: The Court dates back to the time of the first Lament, having built the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative before the Etheric Sea completely enveloped Solaris and cut off the planet from the rest of the universe.

The envelopment of Solaris did not occur all at once, and was slow enough to allow the Court of Savantae to launch the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative to study the Sea in the early stages of the Post-Lament Anthropocene.

While the ruins in Whining Aix's Mire were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court's living membership appears to have been disbanded by the present day. However, it is known they were active as little as two hundred years ago.
Over 200 years ago, the Court collaborated with Sentinel Hsin to construct Xuanfang Hold and maintain its mainframe after the destruction of Yuan Fortress during the Fortress and Gorges War.
A group of researchers expelled by the Committee for their extreme methods went on to build what is now the Court of Savantae Ruins with the patronage of an unidentified male Fractsidus Overseer.

There have been many independent studies on Retroact Rain, most of which were conducted by researches who wanted to relive a previous experience or reunite with their loved ones. However, a group of Court of Savantae researchers expelled by the Committee had attempted a large scale "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project.
Once the Sea reached the station, it was destroyed and crashed into the Roya Frostlands near the north pole, where it has remained until today.
In secrecy, a sect of the Court known as the Celestials yet endure in the modern day, who are living frequency spirits that serve Sentinel Hsin of Mengzhou within Xuanfang Hold's Manifold Sanctum.

As part of an agreement with Hsin at the beginning of its construction, most of its members who constructed the Hold traded their lives to build it in exchange for becoming Celestials, living frequencies who exist within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, and maintain its operations as part of their eternal duty to the Moon Fox.

The Court dates back to the time of the first Lament, having built the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative before the Etheric Sea completely enveloped Solaris and cut off the planet from the rest of the universe.
As part of their efforts in researching an ancient civilization, a group of scientists exiled from the Court of Savantae performed an experiment into creating an Artificial Controllable Tacet Field.

defined.text: The Court of Savantae 稷廷 is a research organization with various laboratories scattered across Solaris. It was at the cutting edge of research into the Lament and related phenomena since the original lament 10,000 years ago.

While the ruins in Whining Aix's Mire were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court's living membership appears to have been disbanded by the present day.

Two years prior to the arrival of Rover at the Gorges of Spirits, while searching for answers regarding his father, Xiangli Yao once explored the ruins of a Court of Savantae laboratory outside of Huanglong, where he found what seemed to be a portal deep within.
In secrecy, a sect of the Court known as the Celestials yet endure in the modern day, who are living frequency spirits that serve Sentinel Hsin of Mengzhou within Xuanfang Hold's Manifold Sanctum.
Over 200 years ago, the Court collaborated with Sentinel Hsin to construct Xuanfang Hold and maintain its mainframe after the destruction of Yuan Fortress during the Fortress and Gorges War.

Before the founding of Jinzhou, Xuanfang Hold was established north of the Clouded Cliffs by Sentinel Hsin and Mengzhou's frontier court to contain and divide the Tacet Discord outbreak flowing from Norfall Barrens. It was built atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War in collaboration with the Court of Savantae.
Zhuojun Atelier was one of two factions of mechanists based in Mengzhou, with the other being the Mengzhou branch of the Court of Savantae.

Reeling from Yuan Fortress' catastrophic self-destruction as a sacrifice by the Court of Savantae and the Xuanfang Wardens to regain a regional advantage against the Tacet Discord threat, he was overwhelmed by the countless horrors of war and strife he witnessed and snapped, experiencing a Resonator awakening in the midst of his insanity.

Through the Dark Tide, where Rinacita's subconscious beliefs flow and is made manifest, Leviathan used the conflict Cristoforo caused across Ragunna and Septimont to cause fear which in turn shaped the citizens desires for a blissful afterlife after death, which constructed the Journeying Paradise from these prayers where upon full manifestation, combined with Leviathan's power of assimilation, everyone will be forcibly made to have no thoughts and simply pray towards Leviathan with no will beyond blind devotion.

voicelines.title: About Hiyuki
voicelines.text: That miko from Ashinohara is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story. She wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret? If growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?

voicelines.title: About Denia
voicelines.text: I... believe I failed her, in a way. Had I been quicker to see through the Fractsidus's plot, she might not have suffered as she did. I borrowed your strength when I delivered that strike. Only then was I able to restore a whisper of her true self back to her. I pray it caused no lasting harm. I am told that she is recovering. If we meet again, I will offer my apologies in person.

voicelines.text: Nia always says, "If you can't finish it, just drop it. Toss away whatever's hard or sad. Running away makes everything so much easier." She never talks about herself, so I can't quite see what's going on in her heart. Still... I hope we can stay friends for a very, very long time.

The envelopment of Solaris did not occur all at once, and was slow enough to allow the Court of Savantae to launch the SkyArk Space Station as part of the Etheric Sea Initiative to study the Sea in the early stages of the Post-Lament Anthropocene.
The SkyArk Space Station uses Etheric Sea as its core.
During one of these global Laments, the planet's axis and magnetic poles shifted to dramatically change the surface climate and ecology, and in the aftermath the Etheric Sea spread over the planet.
Rover likely first appeared in Solaris 10,000 years ago, just as the SkyArk Space Station was destroyed in the final moments of Solaris' envelopment by the Etheric Sea.

The Etheric Sea is a planet-wide phenomena born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky, cutting the planet off from the rest of the universe and bringing all space exploration to a complete standstill as countless spacecraft were lost with space exploration programs abandoned since many satellites, probes, space stations and the like fell from their position and becoming debris upon landing back onto the planet.
The Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords.
The convergence of the Etheric Sea results in the formation of new Tacet Fields, which initially go through a Dormant period, during which the area is relatively safe.
It is highly dangerous to be caught wherever the Etheric Sea converges, as it forms new Tacet Fields and disrupts the functions of Terminals.
The Farwatcher was one of nine interstellar probes launched by the Pre-Lament Civilization in the time before the Etheric Sea enveloped Solaris during the first Lament 10,000 years ago.
The Etheric Sea is a planet-wide phenomena born from an anomalous Lament event.

The Moon is a Waveworn Phenomenon in the sky of Solaris-3, likely some kind of reflection of the Etheric Sea akin to Retroact Rain's ability to conjure up the memories of those caught in it.

Jinzhou's stance toward the Exiles is primarily preventative, with security forces deployed in areas frequented by them.

In the New Federation, Exiles faced extreme discrimination and were blocked from finding legitimate work. They resorted to building camps in the outskirts of the country, which became known as the Lawless Zone.

Due to the class politics of the country, those ostracised by society, including Exiles, were blocked from finding legitimate work and resorted to building camps in the lands that would come to bear the name of the Lawless Zone.

After the Exiles formed gangs throughout the Lawless Zone, the New Federation's government began waging war on the zone's inhabitants to bring it under control, until the war was ended by Calcharo's Ghost Hounds, a mercenary group, who annexed the final gang.
In the New Federation, Exiles faced extreme discrimination and were blocked from finding legitimate work.

In the past, the Exiles established many camps throughout the region as a result of being blocked from pursuing legitimate work within the Federation, causing many to join together to form bandit gangs.
There are systemic class divisions in the New Federation, ranging from the aristocracy which Mortefi belonged to, to the Exiles at the lowest rung of the social hierarchy.

Impoverished regions in the badlands of the country, such as the Lawless Zone have now become a staple of the post-war New Federation, where Exile Groups and mercenary organizations, such as Calcharo's Ghost Hounds, populate the impoverished outskirts of the New Federation.
Though there are criminals such as the Exiles or Talos who use Echoes for criminal activity.
The Exiles 流放者 are a band of various outlaw groups throughout all of Solaris-3 that reject the control of local authorities, and are not an organization with a unified leadership.
Exoswarm are creatures found in Lahai-Roi that are formed from the remnants of the Exostrider.

The Polar Collective would establish diplomatic ties with the Roya and establish its Research Institute on the sword that connects the tropical realm to the surface and holds it up. It is where the Exostrider slumbers, awaiting its final duty.

The Roya tribe uses the lens "Heliogyre," a relic gifted by the Exostrider, to observe the Exostrider's Drive, calculate its trajectory, predict the onset of Void Storm, and provide critical data for the Spacetreck Collective's New Solar Project.

The Homeland Civilization, or Rover's Civilization, is the far-away motherland of Rover and a space-faring civilization. It created the Exostriders and Sentinels to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the Threnodians.

After the second Global Lament, where the massive mecha Exostrider and Threnodian Aleph-1 descended through the Stridergate, the displaced native Roya Tribe were guided to move their major settlements underground in the aftermath.
Lahai-Roi is equipped with an artificial, digital sky and was kept warm via the light of the Reactor Drive, the heart of the Exostrider, until it was replaced by the man-made artificial sun Helios.

They inhabited the country before the planetary shifts occurred which froze the surface, causing them to relocate underground. They built the Solisylum and consider it their calling to guide the growth and migration of Exoswarm by using a calendar created after observing the behaviour of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive.
Lahai-Roi was originally a region without a Sentinel, with the closest thing being the Exostrider; a mechanoid made of the same technology as the Sentinels.
Soliskin are a type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures.

They built the Research Institute, Startorch Academy, Starward Riseway in the vast space beneath the frostlands. Its core mission is the study of the Exostrider for the purposes of advancing and re-instigating space travel technology.
The Stridergate is a connective wormhole that formed when Lahai-Roi's Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris-3.
The Exostrider would later pick up on these signals, recording them and burning them into a cassette which would be gifted to Rover and the people of Lahai-Roi during Starlights from Yesterdays.
Aleph-1 is an extraterrestrial Threnodian that was drifting between the space of the Homeland Civilization and Solaris-3, before intercepting the Exostrider Baldur.

After Aemeath sacrificed herself to travel back in time through Voidspace in order to pilot the Exostrider and seal it underneath Sundermere as part of a closed loop, it was pursued and defeated by Rover and the combined efforts of Startorch Academy, the Spacetrek Collective, and the newly-awakened Exostrider.

Many eventually faded, though during the crisis upon Aleph-1's attempt in entering Solaris-3, the devoured humans managed to create coordinates within Voidspace by working together despite the impossibility of such an act by coordinating and passing on their work towards those within until they succeeded and gave Aemeath the required knowledge for her to pass onto Rover so they and both the Roya and Spacetrek Collective may translate and decode the coordinates to locate the Exostrider to defeat Aleph-1.
The region's wildlife consists exclusively of Exoswarm, mimetic mechanical flora and fauna formed from the remnant pieces of the Exostrider which replaced the extinct species of pre-Lament Lahai-Roi.
Exoswarm are creatures found in Lahai-Roi that are formed from the remnants of the Exostrider.

They inhabited the country before the planetary shifts occurred which froze the surface, causing them to relocate underground. They built the Solisylum and consider it their calling to guide the growth and migration of Exoswarm by using a calendar created after observing the behaviour of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive.
Soliskin are a type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures.

Unbeknownst to many, Jinhsi had also inherited the Sentinel's Temporal Program, including the one it had lost, due to her Resonance Ability.
Overclocking is a state where a Resonator has lost control of their Forte as a result of overwhelming psychological stress or overexertion of their Resonance Ability.
Natural Resonators have a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual, stable rise. These Resonators have naturally awakened their Forte during their growth.
Individuals such as Muyu and Phrolova also show that Reverberations can be affected by specific methods or Fortes.

In Jinzhou, the Ministry of Development once developed Tacetite Weapons to allow non-Resonator units in the Midnight Rangers fight against Tacet Discord. However, since they did not possess Forte and prolonged exposure posed health risks, the output of the weapons was limited for safety.

defined.text: The Fortress and Gorges War was a large-scale war in Huanglong that was waged to prevent the spread of a large Tacet Discord outbreak that swept into Xuanfang over two centuries ago.
The war was primarily fought across Jinzhou and Mengzhou, where the latter was largely ravaged across the Xuanfang front.
The aftermath of the war saw the founding of Jinzhou and the rebuild of Xuanfang at the hands of Mengzhou, placing Xuanfang Hold under Mengzhou's jurisdiction.
The war was primarily fought across Jinzhou and Mengzhou, where the latter was largely ravaged across the Xuanfang front.
The war wreaked havoc on the lands of Xuanfang, with most of the city's men and women taking up arms to join the battle and Mengzhou sending their greatest armies as aid.

Muyu himself confirms this, stating that even if he had unjust goals for the Reverberations, had he not captured those who died during the Fortress and Gorges War, the lingering Reverberations of the dead would have devolved as Tacet Discords.

The war resulted in the fall of Yuan Fortress, insurmountable damage to Xuanfang and the extinction of the Xuanling Bird.

She sacrificed herself over two centuries ago to save her home village from Ovathrax's Tacet Discord armies during the Fortress and Gorges War, Overclocking in a second awakening to hold them off, and buy her village extra time.

defined.text: The Ghost Hounds are a multinational mercenary group rooted in the New Federation's Lawless Zone, annexed from the gang known as "the Underdogs", both led by Calcharo.

After the Exiles formed gangs throughout the Lawless Zone, the New Federation's government began waging war on the zone's inhabitants to bring it under control, until the war was ended by Calcharo's Ghost Hounds, a mercenary group, who annexed the final gang.
The Ghost Hounds are a multinational mercenary group rooted in the New Federation's Lawless Zone, annexed from the gang known as "the Underdogs", both led by Calcharo.

In the past, the Exiles established many camps throughout the region as a result of being blocked from pursuing legitimate work within the Federation, causing many to join together to form bandit gangs. However, the government eventually declared war on the Exiles, dragging the region into an intense conflict until the Ghost Hounds ended it by annexing all Exile groups in the Lawless Zone under their banner.

defined.text: Suzu is a Legacy Talisman from Ashinohara, in the possession of the Miko of Flaming Sakura, Hiyuki.
While unconfirmed, the mysterious woman may be a part of the Homeland Civilization as she was seen within Imperator's Civilization Capsule in The Bygone Shall Always Return.
Huanglong's original Sentinel was one of the Sentinels created by the Homeland Civilization to defend Solaris-3 from the threat of the Threnodians.

Lahai-Roi is frequently cut off from the rest of Solaris by the Void Storm, a local kind of Waveworn Phenomenon, and for most of its history did not have a Sentinel, with the Collective calling the Exostrider a "Sentinel Analog" prior to its formal promotion to being one, and current research suggests that like the Sentinels it was made with technology from the same civilization.

Each Sentinel were also given a Civilization Capsule, devices so advanced that they are coveted by others such as Leviathan and the Fractsidus for their capability to guide mankind, among other aspects within them.

Their culture, traditions, and current status are unknown with little answers as to what they are. It is possible that the Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organization, may have been a part of this civilization and created the plan which lead to the creation of the Black Shores to safeguard humanity.
Awakened with an unknown past by a mysterious entity, Rover is an amnesiac Arbiter from another world who embarks on a journey to uncover the truth to regain their lost memories.
The Homeland Civilization, or Rover's Civilization, is the far-away motherland of Rover and a space-faring civilization.

Lahai-Roi was originally a region without a Sentinel, with the closest thing being the Exostrider; a mechanoid made of the same technology as the Sentinels. It is one of many Exostriders that were created to transport Sentinels from the Homeland Civilization across space to Solaris-3, but this one in particular was intercepted by Aleph-1 in space and sealed the Threnodian with the help of Aemeath.

Rover likely first appeared in Solaris 10,000 years ago, just as the SkyArk Space Station was destroyed in the final moments of Solaris' envelopment by the Etheric Sea. It is possible that Rover, or other Homeland Civilization compatriots, were monitoring the planet before the onset of the Lament.

In particular, the Homeland Civilization is an extraterrestrial race that come from outside of Solaris-3 and are highly advanced to the point where they are the creators of both the Sentinel mech series and Exostriders.

It created the Exostriders and Sentinels to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the Threnodians. They sent Rover on their mission to defeat the Lament, created the mysterious communications satellite swallowed by Aleph-1, and cut off Rover after they begged to be allowed home.
Aleph-1 is an extraterrestrial Threnodian that was drifting between the space of the Homeland Civilization and Solaris-3, before intercepting the Exostrider Baldur.

The Homeland Civilization, or Rover's Civilization, is the far-away motherland of Rover and a space-faring civilization. It created the Exostriders and Sentinels to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the Threnodians.
What is known and confirmed comes from Aemeath, who, during her travels within Voidspace, explains to Rover parts of their existence in The Star That Voyages Again.

Alongside achieving interstellar travel, it is admitted by some such as Muyu that the technology the Sentinels display or grant are a black box to humanity with no ability to comprehend or understand them. Both the Sentinels and Exostriders were designed in aiding Solaris-3 of the Laments that plague them, suggesting the Homeland Civilization is aware of the Waveworn Phenomenon, and thus granted the two series numerous abilities.

It is possible that the Tethys Institute, a pre-Lament organization, may have been a part of this civilization and created the plan which lead to the creation of the Black Shores to safeguard humanity. It may also be related to the Hé civilisation discovered by researchers in Whining Aix's Mire, the portals created by the rogue researchers of the Court of Savantae Ruins, and the mysterious woman from the beginning of the game.
The early settlers of Hongzhen believed that the Sentinel originated from a faraway star and that its vehicle served as its hibernation pod.

voicelines.title: About "Jué"
voicelines.text: Jué... It is the youngest of all the Huanglong Sentinels, and yet no one is more rigid in following the ordained path. Perhaps it is because of Its Temporal Mandate that It values the weight of each "choice" so dearly. When It came to consult with the Moon Fox on the raising of a city, It had exhausted every ounce of Its computational power in seeking a future for the people... Had I not acted in the Fortress and Gorges War, its fires would have reached the very heart of the Jinmen Pass. Jué had cultivated the seeds of Jinzhou with such care, I could not bear to watch them wither. And now, Jinzhou flourishes with lanterns and laughter, year after year. voicelines.title: About Qingxiao
voicelines.text: The Xuan Paragon appears cold and distant, but she is softer than she lets on. If you need something from her, all it takes is a little persistence, and she will fold. "I will not go," she says of the Waking Moon Festival, yet she never misses a single one. I have always seen that she carried the answer within her heart. She simply needed someone to give her a gentle push. Seeing her finally lay that burden down... it brings me immense joy. Come to think of it, if we were to count by age, I might even call her "Sister Qingxiao"... Oh my, but she must never hear me say that. She would tell me to stop foxing around.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: Hsin is one to follow Her whims, and carries a wealth of emotions unlike any other Sentinel of Huanglong. It was She who first invited me to hold the honorary title of Xuan Paragon in Xuanfang Hold. In those days, She would often come up the mountain, regaling me with anecdotes and trivia, and once She started, She could go on for hours. Only when I played the qin would She fall quiet. Sometimes, as She listened, a flicker of loneliness would cross Her face… She always believed She hid it well from me.

defined.text: The current Hsin is a Fractal Form aspect of the original Hsin the Moon Fox, who succeeded her after the Moon Fox was killed by Balanophora over 200 years before the present story.
It is a central junction located within the Manifold Sanctum of Xuanfang Hold, and is home to many Celestials who serve Hsin throughout the region, along with Suhsin.

voicelines.title: About Suisui
voicelines.text: Now there is a remarkably clever young woman. I have seen so many lose their way in the world of commerce, but she navigates it with purpose, her heart set on something larger than profit, pursuing it with the same innate force as the wind rising over water. She even dared to try and outmaneuver me, a Sentinel, heedless of the consequences! And yet, I knew at a glance—her wish is the same as mine. Besides, she has long since seen through me. So I let her be. And as it turns out... I chose well.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: Unlike the other Sentinels of Huanglong, Hsin doesn't feel like a divinity looking down from on high. Somehow, I see a part of her that's unmistakably "human." Maybe it's because I know how much she loves this mortal world that I dared to stand before her.

mentions.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mentions.text: I'm sorry, Rover, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.

bond.ctx: Suisui struck a secret deal with Hsin, who admires her purpose in commerce.

voicelines.title: About Suoming
voicelines.text: When I was wholly consumed by remolding the Civilization Capsule and building Xuanfang Hold, Mengzhou weathered its trials alone. It was Intendant Suoming who bore the weight of the region's affairs on my behalf. I know she clings to obsessions she has no intention of releasing, using them as fuel to walk through storm and calm alike... Every time I think of it, I am flooded with guilt. I long for the day she finds what she seeks—the peace that only home can bring. For that to happen, I must be the Sentinel she deserves.

voicelines.title: About Hsin the Moon Fox
voicelines.text: After our bitter victory over the Evil Miasma, I resented the Sentinel for failing to appear while the black rain fell upon Huating. But when I finally stood before It, seeing Mengzhou as it was and finding It gravely wounded yet still straining to hold the enemies at bay... How could I hold onto my hatred? In the end, I accepted the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs' mandate and dedicated everything I have to It and to Mengzhou.

voicelines.title: About Hsin
voicelines.text: If we speak of age, Hsin is actually a bit younger than me. Having assisted the Sentinel for so long, watching Her grow into who She is today naturally carries a certain fondness. Whether it was Her solitary effort to remold the Civilization Capsule in the past, or Her finally stepping into Her role as the Sentinel now... Hsin has never once let the Sentinel down.

mentions.title: Thoughts: I
mentions.text: For a century, the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs has spoken on behalf of Hsin the Moon Fox to every Magistrate.

mentions.title: Thoughts: III
mentions.text: At Sentinel Hsin's behest, I joined the Ministry to purge Balanophora's remnants, restore order, and find a path forward.

mentions.title: Suoming's Trouble
mentions.text: I cannot say if it's just my imagination, but ever since Sentinel Hsin returned, Mengzhou seems to have more sunny days.

mentions.title: Ideals
mentions.text: For now, Hsin and Mengzhou's future must come first.

mentions.title: Birthday Wishes
mentions.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping, and may your journey ahead be safe.

mentions.title: Join Team: I
mentions.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping.

voicelines.title: About Xuanqing
voicelines.text: Though I never truly met her, she remains vividly undimmed, unfaded, as real as breath and bone within the Moon Fox's memories. I sometimes wonder, had she never existed, would the Sentinel have ever thought to create me? Emotion... is the hardest thing to put into words.

mentions.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mentions.text: But a newborn consciousness can't handle too much feeling all at once. She needed time to learn. "Joy," "sorrow," "anger," "fear"... She sealed these emotions away, and as "Hsin" lived among mortals, She gradually received them.

defined.text: It was at odds with the Threnodian Leviathan for centuries.

Like Ragunna and Septimont, it is made out of islands deep in the Stormy Sea and shares their common history, being settled by ocean wanderers who came to the Rinascitan archipelago under the guidance and protection of the Sentinel Imperator.

As revealed in Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, the Montelli family extended the invitation to the Black Shores, facilitating Rover's visit to their Sentinel, Imperator, with whom they had previously formed a pact.
The Order of the Deep is a Ragunnesi faction that worships the Sentinel, Imperator, and claim to act as the Sentinel's representative.

Their fight ended in Imperator's tragic loss, and its assimilation into the Threnodian. This caused the intensification of Rinascita's spiritual corruption for generations, as Leviathan targeted the faith and doctrine of the Order of the Deep in the guise of the Sentinel.
The Order claims that only Imperator can grant absolution to these transgressors.

Ragunna is the largest known city-state in Rinascita, ruled by the Order of the Deep and centred on its thriving port city. It is protected by the Sentinel Imperator and the local Ragunessi maintain the strongest connection to Them in all of Rinascita.

The Order of the Deep handle various affairs, from city management, diplomacy and overseeing all Common Echoes. They have declared themselves Imperator's earthly emissaries, ensuring the people remain faithful to Their (Imperator's) divine will.
The Carnevale, the grandest celebration in Ragunna, is held as a tribute to Imperator and Their deeds.
Although the city-states do not share a single political entity, they share a common history, origin as wanderers across the oceans, and the protection of the Sentinel Imperator.
In the modern day, during the events of The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier, Rover searched for Imperator with the aid of Cartethyia and Cantarella.
Through manipulating the Order of the Deep, it maintained the lie to the public that Cartethyia was the Sentinel's chosen.

Unlike Ragunna, Septimont has a far more militant and irreligious culture, as it places far less importance on the primacy of the Sentinel Imperator and instead worships the Lioness of Glory Arsinosa.
Fleurdelys also used her power to seal and invert the entire seminary inside of a Sonoro Sphere hidden in the skies of Rinascita.

voicelines.text: Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... voicelines.text: I rarely visit the Temple to pray for revelations, so I can't say I know the Priestesses well. But I do like Iuno. Many of the nobles can't stand her unconventional ways, but I find her boldness entertaining. Don't you?

voicelines.text: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. voicelines.text: There's an old story. A girl went looking for a Transcendent in the mountains, panicked when she ran into Tacet Discords, and fell off a cliff. At the last second, she was saved by a flying sword. That girl? That was my Shifu's old lady. I heard that story a thousand times as a kid. Honestly? Never believed a word of it. Until I saw someone flying across the sky on a blade... There aren't any divinities in Xuanfang, but there is the Xuan Paragon.

voicelines.title: About Jingran
voicelines.text: Years ago, his master crossed paths with me and casually asked for a divination before venturing into a Mirage Realm. I know only a little of the art, but I obliged regardless... It was an ill omen. Yet he simply grinned and went on. Later, this young man took up his master's mantle, the smile on his face even more defiant. Even if the road ahead is treacherous and life is fleeting, to live unburdened and unbound... I suppose that, too, is a life well lived.

voicelines.title: About Suisui
voicelines.text: The famous Madam Chongming Pruner... efficient, sharp-minded, and knows her way around all sorts. The Zhaoming Commerce Guild keeps growing with her at the helm. Rare goods from cities in and even outside of Huanglong keep flowing through her hands. Hm, color me impressed—I've seen my fare share of relics and curios. But if she's got the touch to gather all these lost treasures and put them back on the market... hah, that takes real skill.

voicelines.title: About Jingran
voicelines.text: The Cat of the Nether Lamp… the rumors make him sound like a ghost story. A figure in black, drifting through shadows with a Nether Lamp and the chill of the netherworld clinging to him. I've only met him a few times. Despite his youth, his eyes have the look of someone who has weathered storms that would break lesser men. He is utterly uninhibited, and it makes me curious: is there anything in this world that could actually hold him back?

voicelines.text: "Qingloong rise, monsters gone"... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the Tacet Discords will never breach our borders.

voicelines.title: About Jinhsi
voicelines.text: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to Jinzhou, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.

At one point, a group of individuals young enough to survive the aging, one of them being Rover left Mt. Firmament and founded Jinzhou.
As the border fortress of the nation, it is referred to as the throat of Huanglong, and is the site of many great battles against the Tacet Discord threat lead by the Threnodian Ovathrax.
Its remains now float in the air with a menacing black hole behind it, reminding all of Jinzhou what came before.

When it rains across a large area, it can project memories of multiple people at once, and in a battleground such as Jinzhou, this would result in thousands of Phantoms of dead soldiers and Tacet Discords.
In Jinzhou, the Ministry of Development once developed Tacetite Weapons to allow non-Resonator units in the Midnight Rangers fight against Tacet Discord.
In Jinzhou, the Utility Function of the Terminal has upgraded modules with regards to security and communication.

Each Threnodian embodies a certain fear of struggle, which has a deep connection to the area that faces them, such as Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War, in Jinzhou, a land that has been a battleground for centuries.
Tiger's Maw is a region in Huanglong located to the south of Jinzhou, most notable for its large mine.

voicelines.title: About Jiyan
voicelines.text: In Jinzhou, the liondance tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our Liondance Troupe has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.

voicelines.title: About Sigrika
voicelines.text: She's just the cutest, isn't she? Pure, honest, trying so hard to carry the weight of the world on those tiny shoulders. Breaks my heart. But given my position, even a gentle pat on the cheek would likely only make her more anxious.

voicelines.title: About Lucilla
voicelines.text: President Lucilla's classes are so much fun. When she taught the history of Royan clothing, she even turned it into an impromptu styling workshop! But getting into her classes is almost impossible. Every time the course listings go up, I have to glue myself to the screen and click as fast as I can, or they'll be gone in seconds! And on the professor review forum, her page is just full of students complaining, "How can someone who teaches everything have classes that fill up in seconds?!"

mentions.text: Precisely. It told Sigrika she would always return. To make that happen, it will have to issue a new riddle.

mentions.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows

mentions.title: The Wind Before the Storm

If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.

voicelines.text: Lucy... Dunno where to even start. Known her a while now, but can't say I really get her, y'know? Far as her netrunnin' skills go, she's a freakin' code wizard, can't deny that. I guess... no matter what, Lucy's crew. That answer your question?

It seems that whenever someone's feeling down, he's always there, checking on them, talking with them for as long as they need. They suggested things like "Startorch's Best Counselor" or "Best Doctor and Best Advisor." But if you ask me… I think I'd just write, "The One Who Always Has Candy."

voicelines.title: About Mornye
voicelines.text: What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.

voicelines.title: About Lynae
voicelines.text: I wish to be like her, having the freedom to do what she wants. To act without constraint. Especially the constraint of a class schedule. It's a pity that professors are forbidden to skip their own lectures…

Ostina is the name of an ancient town in an unknown nation. It is the birthplace of Phrolova, and it is recreated in her Sonoro Sphere called the Lost Beyond.
While usually a harmless phenomenon in itself, the Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords, and the power of a Threnodian can greatly enhance the effects of the rain.

The first recorded instance of Threnodian-enhanced Retroact Rain ever happening was during the Battle Beneath the Crescent, fought against Ovathrax in the Norfall Barrens, three years prior to the start of the story.

During the events of Chapter I: Jinzhou Rising, he saw the potential in Rover to absorb the recently revived Threnodian Ovathrax's champion, the Crownless, making them a prime candidate for the organization.

Each Threnodian embodies a certain fear of struggle, which has a deep connection to the area that faces them, such as Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War, in Jinzhou, a land that has been a battleground for centuries.

Ovathrax is a cunning wartime strategist capable of directing Tacet Discords with an unprecedented level of military strategy and movements, while Aleph-1 is a detached, soft-spoken cosmic destroyer with a fatalist philosophy.
The presence of a Threnodian can further amplify the phenomenon’s effects as seen during the Battle Beneath the Crescent with the Threnodian, Ovathrax.

She sacrificed herself over two centuries ago to save her home village from Ovathrax's Tacet Discord armies during the Fortress and Gorges War, Overclocking in a second awakening to hold them off, and buy her village extra time.

During the Tacet Discord Outbreak caused by Ovathrax, desperate to save her village and others like it, Xuanqing baited the Tacet Discords to the choke point as a trap, and asked Hsin about performing the Second Awakening to buy more time to save them.
In response to the threat of Ovathrax, Hsin the Moon Fox summoned the two factions to Mengzhou City Hall in order to deliberate between which faction would be best suited to construct Xuanfang Hold.

defined.text: The Resonator War was a large-scale civil war that took place in the New Federation. It was a war fought between ordinary people and Resonators across the country, with the Resonator side occupying the Federated Cities.
The war was split between armed forces across the respective Resonator and non-Resonator fronts.
Rover is a multi-attribute Resonator and the main protagonist of Wuthering Waves.
He is a Resonator, and his Tacet Mark is located across his neck.

Sentinels are only able to resonate with one Resonator at a time, and the breaking of this law will result in both the Sentinel and its current Resonator having their frequencies rent asunder, destroying them.

This process also physically separated Solaris from the rest of the universe, killing civilisation's budding spaceflight capabilities in its cradle, and gave rise to the Waveworn Phenomena, a series of anomalous occurrences resulting from the destabilization of natural laws. However, thanks to the Lament, humans have gained the ability to resonate and manipulate frequencies, giving rise to Resonators.
A Tacet Mark is a symbol that appears on every Resonator's body at the time of their Awakening.
When modified, Tacetite can become a potent energy weapon for Resonators, capable of harming the Tacet Discords.

defined.text: Terminal is a device used by Resonators.

Over the past 10,000 years, five global Lament events and more than 300,000 regional instances have been recorded, indicating a recurring and persistent pattern of large-scale disruption. These events have led to the emergence of individuals known as Resonators—those who have adapted to, or been shaped by, the residual energy of the Lament.

Reeling from Yuan Fortress' catastrophic self-destruction as a sacrifice by the Court of Savantae and the Xuanfang Wardens to regain a regional advantage against the Tacet Discord threat, he was overwhelmed by the countless horrors of war and strife he witnessed and snapped, experiencing a Resonator awakening in the midst of his insanity.

parallel.summary: A civil war framed as a class war, fought across a federation with trains carrying aid and troops, in a country whose own sayings echo Russia.

points.game: The Federated Cities were caught in “a class war between the New Federation's Resonator and non-Resonator populations”, escalating into a large-scale civil war.
points.real: The two largest combatants were the Red Army, fighting for the establishment of a Bolshevik-led socialist state headed by Vladimir Lenin, and the forces known as the White movement.

points.game: The Resonator front “distributed emergency aid and reinforcements by train” from the Federated Cities to regions such as the Fifth Sector.
points.real: The most intensive use of armoured trains was during the Russian Civil War (1918–1920).

points.game: A New Federation saying, quoted as from the “Old Federation”: “Solaris is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”
points.real: In a letter written in 1911 he [Tsiolkovsky] indicated his belief that, “Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever.”

against: The Bolsheviks won and built a socialist state; the New Federation's winners built a capitalist, corporate one.
The sides are Resonators and ordinary people, not political camps.

They possess Tacet Cores, also known by the academic community as Reverberation Bodies and instinctively feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve.

inspired.text: Aside from succession via gladitorial kratocracy, Septimont's system of government somewhat resembles that of ancient Sparta, with the Ephor and Priestess of Septimont advised by a Council of Elders bearing similarities to the Two Kings of Sparta who are in turn advised, ironically, by five individuals holding the title of Ephor, though the Elders are more akin to the Gerousia. Though, unlike the Spartan Ephors and Gerousia, the Septimont Council of Elders have no judicial authority over the Ephor and Priestess.

defined.text: Tetragon Temple, more commonly known as The Tetragon, is a faction consisting of the Priestesses of Septimont.

The Moon plays an important role in many cultures in Solaris. Both Jinzhou and Septimont use the moon's reflection for fortune-telling, while the Moon-Chasing Festival of Huanglong remains one of its most important traditional festivals.
Minor manifestations related to the Dark Tide were also introduced in Septimont, specifically the occurrence of the Blightcloud, the High Tide, and the Tidal Blight.

In the ancient past the planet was ravaged by a series of global catastrophes known collectively as The Lament.

"The Lament" (Chinese: 悲鸣, "lament" or "wail of sorrow") is a term used to describe a series of catastrophic mass-extinction phenomena that have affected the planet Solaris-3, and is one of the primary driving narratives in Wuthering Waves.
The Moon is a Waveworn Phenomenon in the sky of Solaris-3, likely some kind of reflection of the Etheric Sea akin to Retroact Rain's ability to conjure up the memories of those caught in it.

defined.text: Most Threnodians on Solaris-3 are a reflection of the collective fears of humanity condensed into physical form, born from the dark side of collective consciousnesses.
A single Threnodian's revival is never an independent occurrence, as they can sense each other through some form of telepathic link and can trigger catastrophic events across Solaris-3.
Due to the Etheric Sea, aerospace flight was restricted across Solaris-3.

This process also physically separated Solaris from the rest of the universe, killing civilisation's budding spaceflight capabilities in its cradle, and gave rise to the Waveworn Phenomena, a series of anomalous occurrences resulting from the destabilization of natural laws.
Waveworn Phenomenon (Chinese: 海蚀现象, "Coastal Erosion Phenomenon") is a collective term used to describe anomalies caused directly by the influence of The Lament in Solaris-3.
As noted in Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians, The Lament unleashed waves of destruction that had an "erosive" effect upon Solaris-3.

voicelines.title: About Yangyang
voicelines.text: Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all. Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. My sister may look soft and unassuming, but there is a resilience in her that runs deeper than anyone realizes. When you need the wind, she brings it to you. When you face the gale, she stands as your shield. This, I've always known.

voicelines.title: About Mother
voicelines.text: People know her as a master composer, but to me, she remains that gentle presence on the porch, pulling my sister and me into her arms on rainy days to tell us stories of the world beyond. I was always pressing her for what came next, while Yangyang would just watch her in quiet, wide-eyed wonder. Hehe, I suppose that was the rhythm of our childhood.

voicelines.title: About Youhu
voicelines.text: She's got a real knack for appraising antiques, and knows all about where the rare old paintings are kept. If she hadn't told me where to find those friendly collectors, I'd never have gotten to see the originals with my own eyes. Though she's never told me how she gets her info, I can tell it's not easy. So now and then, I slip some money into her pocket when she's not looking!

bond.ctx: Youhu pointed Zhezhi to collectors of rare old paintings.
